name: MUNAISZNTECHS™
description: MUNAISZNTECHS™ is a powerful multi-device WhatsApp automation bot developed with Node.js. Featuring advanced command execution, session-based authentication, media processing, automated messaging and database integration.
logo_description: Official MUNAISZNTECHS™ brand logo. A premium futuristic circular emblem featuring a deep black background, metallic silver lettering, sharp custom typography, luminous turquoise and cyan neon accents, a glowing circular border, and the MUNAISZNTECHS™ name. The design represents advanced technology, innovation, reliability and digital excellence.

SESSION_ID.description: WhatsApp authentication session string required to connect and initialize the bot.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Bot administrator WhatsApp number in international format without the plus sign. Example: 2547XXXXXXXX.

DATABASE_URL.description: Optional MongoDB, PostgreSQL or MySQL database connection URL.

BOT_OWNER.description: Official bot developer and owner name.

COMMAND_MODE.description: Controls whether bot commands are accessible publicly or privately.

REMOVEBG_KEY.description: Optional remove.bg API key for image background removal.
